_comment: Chart theme for mermaid-render. Two decisions matter here and both are
measured rather than chosen by eye.
SERIES COLOURS. Slots 1 and 2 of a validated categorical palette: blue
#2a78d6 and orange #eb6834. Checked with the data-viz validator against
this surface — worst-pair CVD separation 24.7 (protan) and 32.7 (tritan)
against a target of 8, normal-vision 33.6 against a floor of 15. Red and
green would have been the obvious pair for burndown and are the one
combination that fails for the most common colour blindness.
EVERYTHING ELSE RECESSIVE. Axes, ticks and grid lines are ink, not colour:
the data carries the colour, the scaffolding does not compete with it. The
chart is read as a small PNG in a chat window, where a bright grid is the
first thing that makes it unreadable.
The surface is #fcfcfb rather than pure white, which keeps the marks from
vibrating against the background at chat-image size.

themeVariables.fontFamily: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
